history.note: Fixed c=0.2 tangent surrogate; a mechanistic replacement candidate, with no claim of measured improvement. Above floor J=0.2*(I-uu^T). Source SHA256 9bbc138593f91caae102a44923bcb1c882d5a0e510c6a04d469b1552a7a2e135; canonical config SHA256 8d20e2d0d474597cf7453ffa0d4abec48c3b4433e94eadb667002ff6bd1d59e1. Prospective submission only; no local training or torch execution. New diagnostics have 48 label-free scalars on the ordered first 512 validation rows and are not independent backward verification. Local verification completed before host execution: study-schema subset validator, JSON/variant/parent/protocol checks, module compile/AST and allowed-import checks; common constructor, encoding, weights, scorer, logits and forward ASTs match incumbent and all four exposed ancestor gradient arms. New modules have identical class bodies and differ only in literal CONFIG. Source-executed pure-Python scalar automatic differentiation checked 1890 forward/VJP cases across 135 vectors (49 below floor, 2 exactly at boundary, 86 regular including boundaries), active and zero-upstream/masked cases, 224 chain-rule cases through all four product operands and 512 finite-difference components of the true full derivative only. Max forward difference 0; max VJP absolute error 4.55e-13. Scalar clamp derivative assumed active at equality. This is not actual torch execution: tensor/broadcast/dtype/autograd boundary semantics, full-model logits, diagnostic execution, actual gradients/updates, parameters/cost and training/scoring still require host checks. The 48-key diagnostic count was source-checked. No local model training, installations, package writes, seed changes, human/host evidence edits or test access occurred. Retrieval output truncation was resolved by parsing selected public JSON fields; rg was unavailable, so a shallow public file listing was used. Primary-source retrieval initially failed for one NeurIPS PDF URL and one unavailable arXiv HTML version; the alternate primary PDF and versioned HTML were successfully read. These are preparation/interface issues, not failed model trials.

knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved external card describes direct interaction readouts and depth/field mixing. The observed local uncertainty concerns backward scale allocation; adding a highway/readout changes the forward architecture and would not isolate it. Full primary industry text was not needed for an adoption claim because no mechanism is adopted. Task/field mismatch and participant-only evidence remain.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted; current explicit products are inherited local components.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No highway, new head, token/depth, auxiliary loss or optimizer transfer. DIN, local gradient controls and Xu et al. are closer to this experiment.
assessments.falsifier: A later matched-head/depth contrast showing loss of useful direct interactions could motivate this card in a separate prospective study; current scale contrasts cannot verify its mechanism.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved card describes context-conditioned residual transport. Local evidence has not established propagation instability or reliable context fields. More gates or capacity would confound the narrow gradient-allocation question; participant-reported effects from another task do not transfer automatically.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted; no residual transport/context gate or distillation added.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Within-history detached scales modify a surrogate backward rule while holding forward depth and context fixed; this is not contextual residual transport.
assessments.falsifier: A separately authorized representation-depth diagnostic and matched-capacity/shuffled-context controls could test transport later. This experiment supplies neither confirmation nor refutation of CRAFT.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.
